subject.title: Improve macOS onboarding UX and gateway setup

question: Should this protected, conflicting onboarding PR be closed as superseded by the merged macOS onboarding work, or should someone sponsor a narrow rebase for any remaining unique pieces?
rationale: The `maintainer` label prevents automatic cleanup, and deciding whether to preserve any part of this stale branch requires maintainer intent because current main already changed the product direction and the branch has security/auth blockers.

options.title: Close as superseded
options.body: Close this PR after maintainer confirmation, pointing to the merged automatic Gateway setup, Crestodian onboarding, and existing-Gateway dashboard fixes as the canonical path.

options.title: Sponsor a narrow rebase
options.body: Have a maintainer or contributor rebase only the still-desired UI/test pieces, drop superseded wizard/setup changes, and fix the security/auth findings with real macOS proof.

options.title: Keep parked
options.body: Leave the PR open as historical context for macOS onboarding, accepting that it is not a merge candidate in its current shape.

recommendation.title: Close as superseded
recommendation.body: Close this PR after maintainer confirmation, pointing to the merged automatic Gateway setup, Crestodian onboarding, and existing-Gateway dashboard fixes as the canonical path.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete owns the recent merged macOS onboarding direction that determines whether this stale branch should close or be narrowed.
